summary: Loads one career season standings entry from an ini-style token buffer. Iterates tokens via ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag over unk_8AC1E8 while the buffer is active. Handles Name/VehFile/RcdFile entries by copying the string; parses indexed FinishPosition and FinishPoints keys (formatted with the '%s%2.2d' pattern) into per-index byte offsets this+24 and this+216; writes season totals (SeasonPoints, PointsPosition, PolesTaken, OriginalGridPos, CurrentGridPos, ControlType) to this+408..428; and sets the active flag byte this+0x1B0 from the parsed 'Active' field. Returns 1 once any entry was processed, 0 otherwise.

operations.description: If the dword pointed to by a2 is zero, skip loading entirely and return the unset processed flag.
While ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(&unk_8AC1E8, 256) yields the next token, iterate; set processed flag v2 = 1.
sub_5651B0(&unk_8AC050) checks scene setup; if the result is 1 or 4 (i.e. result-1 is 0 or 3), return the processed flag early.
When the token matches 'Name' (aName_2), 'VehFile' (aVehfile) or 'RcdFile' (aRcdfile), copy it into the token buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

Look up the key formed by 'FinishPosition' + '%%s%%2.2d' index via sub_587C20; when found, parse the trailing index v10 with sub_587ECE, and if v10 < 0x30 format '%s%2.2d' and write the entry to this + 24 + 4*v10.

Look up the key formed by 'FinishPoints' + '%%s%%2.2d' index via sub_587C20; when found, parse the trailing index v14 with sub_587ECE, and if v14 < 0x30 format '%s%2.2d' and write the entry to this + 216 + 4*v14.

Write season summary fields with sub_565760: SeasonPoints to this+408, PointsPosition to this+412, PolesTaken to this+416, OriginalGridPos to this+420, CurrentGridPos to this+424, ControlType to this+428.
Parse the 'Active' field into v15 via sub_565760; when it returns nonzero, set the byte this+0x1B0 (this[432]) to whether v15 is nonzero.
Return the processed flag v2 (1 if any token was handled, 0 if the buffer was empty).

clean_pseudocode: write(SeasonPoints, this+408); write(PointsPosition, this+412); write(PolesTaken, this+416);
write(OriginalGridPos, this+420); write(CurrentGridPos, this+424); write(ControlType, this+428);
unresolved: Meaning of the 256 constant passed to ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag is not established.
sub_5651B0 result semantics (only results that are 1 or 4 cause an early return) are not confirmed beyond this function.
sub_565760's return value (used only for the 'Active' lookup) is assumed to signal key-present; not independently verified.
a2 points to a validity flag for the token buffer; the buffer itself is unk_8AC1E8 global state.
Only field 0x1B0 was extracted for this function; the this+408..428 writes and this+24/216 indexed arrays have no field evidence entries and are therefore described from raw source only.
